name: metavr_files
description: File operations on a connected Meta Quest headset via metavr. Actions: ls (path; all=hidden optional; default /sdcard/), push (src=local, dest=remote), pull (src=remote, dest=local optional), rm (path; recursive optional — destructive), mkdir (path; parents=true default). Pass `target` serial when multiple headsets are connected.

action.description:
Action to run. One of:
- ls: list files on the device (path=<remote path> optional, default '/sdcard/'; all=true|false to include hidden)
- push: upload a local file (src=<local path>, dest=<remote path>)
- pull: download a file from the device (src=<remote path>; dest=<local path> optional, defaults to current directory)
- rm: delete a file or directory (path=<remote path>; recursive optional bool) — destructive
- mkdir: create a directory (path=<remote path>; parents optional bool, default true)

all.description: Show hidden files. Only used with action='ls'.

dest.description: Destination path. Required for push (remote); optional for pull (defaults to current directory).

parents.description: Create parent directories as needed. Only used with action='mkdir' (default: true).

path.description: Remote path on the device. Used by ls / rm / mkdir; defaults to '/sdcard/' for ls.

recursive.description: Recursively delete a directory. Only used with action='rm'.

src.description: Source path. Required for push (local) and pull (remote).

target.description: Device serial used to disambiguate when more than one device is connected. Optional; passed to metavr as the global `--device <serial>` flag.
